async def act(page):
    # Click the Customers link to ensure the dropdown menu is open
    customers_link = page.get_by_role("menubar").get_by_role("link", name=" Customers")
    await customers_link.click()
    # Wait a moment for the menu to appear
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Click the 'All Customers' link in the menu to navigate to the customers page
    all_customers_link = page.get_by_role("menu").get_by_role("link", name="All Customers")
    await all_customers_link.click()
    # Wait for navigation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
